items.title: Agricultural Control
items.summary: Agricultural Control: practical prevention and treatment guidelines.
items.content:
[Overview]
Agricultural Control emphasizes prevention, reduced reliance on broad-spectrum chemicals, and practices compatible with local regulations.

[Key practices]
Combine orchard sanitation, monitoring, cultural adjustments, and registered products only when thresholds are reached.
